selection_metric: validation ROC-AUC; no test-based model selection

cost_assumptions.interpretation: illustrative cost units; no verified realized savings

notes: Rate intervals are pointwise 95% Wilson intervals, not multiple-comparison adjusted.
Financial histograms clip display values at p99 and use logarithmic count axes; model inputs are not clipped.
Monthly training comparisons are not out-of-time model validation.
Bureau descriptions with fewer than 500 applications remain in CSV but are omitted from the chart.

extended_experiments.scope: training and validation only; challengers do not replace the primary family selection
notes: Outer-fold evaluation rebuilds imputation and target encoding in every fold.
The model family was selected using a separate validation set before its training-only CV diagnostics.
Seed experiments change estimator randomness while holding data split and encoding fixed.
A small challenger grid is exploratory and not an exhaustive hyperparameter search.

operations.status: offline routing and monitoring demonstration; integration remains a design

routing_actions.Priority review: Prioritize human review; no automatic rejection

operations.monitoring_scope: training reference vs random validation split; no live drift or future-period evidence
operations.bootstrap_scope: pointwise stratified row intervals, conditional on observed prevalence and frozen model; no fitting uncertainty

limitations: Random application split; no out-of-time or unseen-entity validation.
Validation set reused for model selection and policy choice; selection uncertainty remains.
Class-weighted scores are uncalibrated and are not probability-of-default estimates.
Review cap is fitted on validation; test or future flag rates can exceed it.
Cost scenario assumes every flagged default loss is avoided and charges margin only for flagged non-defaults.
Review does not itself prevent default; workload costs and actual interventions are not modeled.
Geographic, staff, age, and identity-document features need fairness and availability review.
Previously explored public dataset; held-out results are an internal benchmark, not external validation.
